observations: Photo 0 shows a bicycle lying on its side on cracked concrete ground.
The bike has knobby tires, a front suspension fork, disc brake mounts, and rear derailleur gears.
The frame appears green or olive with no readable brand or model name visible in the photo.
A watermark reading "EZEKIEL" is visible across the image.
The background is a rough wall with exposed blue and white pipes.

claims.evidence: No country-of-origin marking is readable in photo 0.
A still photo cannot demonstrate gear shifting.
A still photo cannot demonstrate brake function.

risks.risk: Frame cracks or structural damage at welds and joints
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the head tube, bottom bracket, seat tube, and rear dropouts

risks.risk: Gear shifting or derailleur not functioning
risks.proof: Video of the pedals turning while shifting through all gears

risks.risk: Brakes not functioning on front or rear wheel
risks.proof: Video of both brake levers being squeezed and the wheels stopping
Video of each wheel spinning freely and close-up photos of tire tread and sidewalls

proof_requests: Close-up photos of the bicycle frame joints, especially head tube, bottom bracket, and seat tube
Video showing the gears shifting through all ranges while the rear wheel spins
Video showing both brake levers applied and the wheels stopping
Close-up photos of both tires and video of each wheel spinning to check for wobble
response.reason: The item is clearly a bicycle, so it can be priced at its worst case as a non-working bike; unproven claims about gears and brakes do not prevent pricing.
